result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/ sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching, feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery.
AFE 5 positions available for this role.

JOB SUMMARY:
The deckhand will carry out duties as directed by the Farm Manager or Vessel Masters.

OPERATIONS:
Periods at sea are varied and weather dependent. Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs.
Farm Operations:
Farm vessels can be required to conduct operations year round from land based sites out to the farming site. The season begins in December finishing with the annual harvest period throughout June, July & August.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day

Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. There are however periods of downtime.

CONTRACT PERIOD:
Approximate start date: AFE are offering start dates in November, December, January, February, March and April  for up to 9 Months

DUTIES:
The Employee will be required to perform the following duties whilst at sea on the Farm site.
• Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master
• Forklift operation (license required) onshore only (not essential but desirable)
• Loading and unloading of vessel at sea and on-shore
• Fish feeding, harvesting & processing
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel mooring/berthing
• Net mending
• Rope work (splicing, knotting etc.)
• Farm pontoon maintenance

OFFSHORE DUTIES:
The Employee will be required to perform the following duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring

A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.
Deck Duties:
• Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
• Net mending

Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. There are however downtime periods. For example, if the vessel is steaming to different fishing grounds or is at anchor for the day due to weather the crew can indulge in R&R but will still be required to man a navigational watch in the evening.

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

INDUCTION & TRAINING:
• All crew are inducted onto the vessel prior to departure
• Safety drills conducted bi-monthly
• Deck machinery training and instruction conducted
• SOP’s to be discussed for operations

REMUNERATION:
FARM OPERATIONS
Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.
result.title: Deckhand

Vacancy Listing Dates 21/07/2026 to 18/08/2026
- Experienced Professionals wanted!
- Remuneration from $90,000 to $190,000
- Join the team at MLG Oz

MLG Oz is a West Australian owned and operated business with operations located throughout WA and NT.

We are currently looking for Welders / Boilermakers, Motor Mechanics, Diesel Motor Mechanics, Fitters, Metal Fabricators, Industrial Electricians & Auto Electricians across all of our sites.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Relevant trade qualifications required to perform your duties
- Minimum 3 years' exp. with a demonstrated safety and performance record
- Sound knowledge of workshop and remote site operations
- Experience reading, interpreting, following and communicating information on written job instructions, specifications, standard operating procedures, charts, lists, drawings and other applicable reference documents
- Demonstrated ability to work in multi-disciplinary work teams

You will be required to:
- Undertake repairs and servicing to MLG Oz plant and equipment as indicated by the site supervisor
- Maintain applicable service and operation records
- Order material and parts required for repairs and servicing of oxy and welding plant and equipment in consultation with the Leading Hand and Purchasing Officer/Store person
- Test run site plant and equipment following repairs
- Liaise with the Leading Hand and Site Supervisor on plant and equipment repairs
- Ensure your work environment is maintained through daily housekeeping and equipment inspections
- Take reasonable care to ensure your personal safety and health and that of other personnel whilst in the workplace
- Undertake any other works as directed by the Workshop Supervisor, within your skills and abilities
- Comply with policies, procedures and all safety requirements of MLG Oz and their client whilst on site
- Facilitate the achievement of MLG Oz's goals and objectives relevant to the Kalgoorlie Workshop

We are also currently seeking an experienced Mining Engineer to join our team in Goldfields.

In this role you will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

You will be expected to ensure that projects are completed on-time, within the allocated budget, and are resourced accordingly. There will be travel to client facilities to oversee implementation and ongoing reporting and compliance.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:
- Always observe company health and safety requirements and regulations
- Establish professional relationships with staff
- Maintain a high degree of professionalism and diligence
- Prepare plans with detailed drawings that include project specifications and cost estimates
- Design and execute engineering experiments to create workable solutions
- Develop engineering calculations, diagrams and technical reports
- Complete required technical and regulatory documents
- Ensure projects are completed on time and within the specified budget
- Present analysis results and project solutions to technical leads, senior leaders and clients as necessary
- Identify areas where improvements and savings could be made, or efficiencies generated
- Travel to sites operations as required

To be considered for this role, the successful applicant will possess:
- 3+ years' related work exp.
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering
- Drivers Licence
- Initiative in problem solving within assigned tasks
- Able to perform effectively within a team environment
- Demonstrated proficiency in written and verbal communication, including creating and delivering presentations
- Advanced skills in critical software applications
- Expertise in data and problem analysis, creative problem solving and design thinking

Additionally, we are seeking a Civil Engineer to join our team. Applicants must have at least 3 years' related work exp. and hold a Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering.

The Civil Engineer will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

Remuneration packages from $90,000 - $190,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

We are also seeking an experienced Occupational Health and Safety Inspector / HSE Advisor to join our site based Crushing and Screening operations.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Certificate IV OHS
- Section 44 Appointed Person
- Ability to pass a Pre-employment medical, incl. Drug & Alcohol screen
- 3+ years' experience in system and documentation development
- Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages, particularly Word and Excel
- A high attention to detail to ensure high quality work outcomes.

The following will also be highly regarded:
- Diploma of Occupational/Workplace Health and Safety
- 3+ years relevant mine site experience/crushing plants
- Previous machine operator experience.
- Cert IV Training and Assessment.

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $130,000 will be offered to the successful candidate

We are also seeking Drainers to join our team. You will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of drainage systems on civil and mining projects. This position involves working in remote environments as part of a skilled wider-earthworks crew, ensuring all drainage infrastructure is constructed to specification, safely, and efficiently. You will be expected to have strong experience in trenching, pipe laying, Tailings Storage Facilities and reading construction plans, along with a solid understanding of site safety standards and environmental considerations. You will be expected to operate machines at times on drainage jobs but also when drainage works are intermittent on the rest of the project.

The role requires adaptability to demanding site conditions and a commitment to high-quality workmanship while maintaining productivity targets. A proactive attitude, strong teamwork skills, and the ability to work long shifts in remote FIFO conditions are essential for success in this role.

You will also need to demonstrate a minimum of 3 years work exp.

Responsibilities:
- Install underground drainage systems, including stormwater, subsoil drainage, and TSF infrastructure
- Read and interpret engineering drawings and site plans
- Ideally be able to set out pipe alignments and levels using lasers and surveying equipment
- Excavate trenches and prepare bedding materials
- Lay pipes, align joints, and ensure correct gradients
- Backfill and compact trenches to specification
- Conduct inspections and testing of installed systems
- Operate and work around heavy machinery safely - during drainage works and during other TSF project works.
- Maintain tools, equipment, and a clean work environment

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $110,000 will be offered .

Locations:	 South Brisbane, QLD, 4101
Full-Time:	 Immediate start
Reports to:	 Manager
Job Title:	 Facilities Manager
Salary range:	 $79,500 - $90,000 + Superannuation – depending on skill level
Job Closure date	 30 days

About Our Client
Our client is an iconic luxury hotel, celebrated as a dynamic and sophisticated destination that seamlessly blends modern architectural design with world-class hospitality. This vibrant precinct is more than just a hotel; it is a hub of luxury accommodation, exclusive retail, and award-winning dining and entertainment. Renowned for creating immersive and flawless guest experiences, our client is committed to maintaining an environment of unparalleled quality, comfort, and aesthetic appeal. They are seeking a strategic and hands-on Facilities Manager to become the custodian of their exceptional physical asset.

About the Role
On behalf of our client, we are recruiting for a Facilities Manager to assume full responsibility for the preservation and continuous operation of their prestigious property. This is a pivotal leadership role where technical expertise meets a passion for impeccable standards. You will be tasked with ensuring that every aspect of the hotel’s infrastructure—from the guest rooms and back-of-house areas to the building’s iconic façade and advanced systems—operates at peak performance. Your work will be integral to protecting the asset’s value and, most importantly, ensuring a safe, comfortable, and uninterrupted experience for guests and staff.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
Strategic Asset Management & Planning
• Develop, implement, and manage a comprehensive, proactive preventative maintenance schedule for the entire hotel precinct, encompassing MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems, life safety systems, and building fabric.
• Lead the strategic planning and execution of long-term capital improvement projects, renovations, and refurbishments, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to hotel operations.
• Prepare and meticulously manage the annual facilities operating and capital budgets, conducting detailed cost analysis and implementing cost-control measures without compromising on quality or safety.

Operational Excellence & Guest Experience
• Oversee the daily operations of the hotel’s physical plant, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and other critical building systems, to ensure a consistently perfect environment for guests and staff.
• Manage a prompt and efficient system for responding to and resolving maintenance requests, prioritizing those that impact the guest experience directly.
• Conduct regular and detailed inspections of all public areas, guest suites, and back-of-house facilities to identify and address issues related to wear and tear, ensuring the property always reflects a five-star standard of presentation.

Leadership, Compliance & Safety
• Lead, mentor, and schedule a skilled team of maintenance technicians and tradespeople, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional service.
• Serve as the hotel’s primary expert on Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) compliance, ensuring all practices, contractor management, and documentation adhere to the highest standards of statutory and company policy.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers, negotiating contracts and ensuring all work performed on-site meets the hotel’s rigorous quality and safety requirements.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Proven experience as a Facilities Manager, Chief Engineer, or in a similar senior technical management role within a luxury hotel, high-end residential complex, or a comparable five-star service environment.
• A strong qualification in Engineering, Building Management, or a related trade field, combined with comprehensive knowledge of building codes, WHS legislation, and statutory compliance.
• Demonstrated financial acumen, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and managing significant operational and capital expenditures.
• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to manage, develop, and inspire a technical team and collaborate effectively with other department heads.
• A strategic thinker with a hands-on approach, capable of prioritizing a complex workload in a fast-paced, 24/7 operation.
• A genuine passion for upholding the highest standards of quality and a commitment to supporting a world-class guest experience from an operational and technical standpoint.

To Apply
If you are an accomplished facilities professional ready to steward a landmark luxury property, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your suitability for this critical role.

Please note: All applications are confidential. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment agent for this role, and our client’s identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates

They now seek an experienced Carpenter to join their team in Campbellfield, VIC. 

 

 

The Role 

The Carpenter is responsible for carrying out residential carpentry works including framing, installation, finishing, and structural construction activities in accordance with project specifications and building requirements. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary set at $80,000 plus superannuation. The role is based in Campbellfield, VIC.

result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Road Roller Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Road Roller Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of road rollers to compact soil, gravel, asphalt and other construction materials for roads, hardstands, building platforms and civil infrastructure works. The role is responsible for achieving specified compaction standards while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate road rollers safely and efficiently to compact soil, gravel, crushed rock, asphalt and other construction materials. 
-  Achieve specified compaction standards for roads, hardstands, building pads, foundations and civil infrastructure. 
-  Compact fill layers in accordance with project specifications and engineering requirements. 
-  Perform rolling operations for pavement construction, roadworks, drainage and site preparation activities. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, compaction specifications and supervisor instructions. 
-  Monitor rolling patterns and identify areas requiring additional compaction. 
-  Coordinate safely with graders, excavators, loaders and other mobile plant during earthworks operations. 
-  Conduct daily pre-start inspections and complete required plant inspection documentation. 
-  Monitor equipment performance and report faults or maintenance requirements promptly. 
-  Carry out routine servicing, lubrication and minor maintenance within competency limits. 
-  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox meetings and safety interactions. 
-  Operate safely around personnel, mobile plant, underground services and fixed infrastructure. 
-  Maintain compliance with Grounded, client and statutory safety requirements. 
-  Complete required plant logs, inspection records and production documentation accurately. 
-  Assist with site establishment and other construction activities where required. 
-  Maintain housekeeping standards around work areas and equipment. 
-  Contribute to achieving project production, quality and safety objectives. 

Skills and Abilities:
-  Relevant qualification equivalent to AQF Certificate II or Certificate III, or equivalent industry experience. 
-  Minimum one (1) year relevant experience operating road rollers. 
-  Current Driver’s Licence (HR – MC Role Dependant) 
-  Operating SOA 
-  Operating VOC (2 years validity)


Salary range is $75,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 20th July 2026 and closes on 20th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
